title: A Correlation Aware Quantum Feature Map for Variational Quantum Classification
summary: Quantum machine learning has emerged as a promising research area for learning complex data patterns. However, most existing quantum feature maps employ fixed encoding strategies that do not explicitly consider the relationships among features within a dataset. In this study, we propose a Correlation Aware Quantum Feature Map (CAQFM) which integrates feature dependencies into the quantum encoding process.
